dataset.title: GHCN-Daily Version 3: twelve Northeast and Mid-Atlantic US stations, TMAX, 2018–2020
dataset.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
dataset.version: Pinned NCEI access-service response; underlying historical observations and station metadata may be revised

ghcnd-tmax-2018-2020.csv.gz.processing: Complete CSV response bytes, losslessly gzip-compressed with mtime=0; no rows, columns or source flags removed

selection: Twelve named long-running stations chosen by geography before inspecting returned temperatures; 2018–2019 reference and 2020 evaluation fixed before fitting. This short reference is not a 30-year climate normal.

units.TMAX: degrees Celsius returned by metric API; daily maximum, not daily mean temperature
units.coordinates: source latitude/longitude in degrees; no source datum stated by this CSV
units.date: Gregorian observing-date label; exact UTC observation interval not supplied

quality_flags.accepted: Only empty quality flag and finite TMAX; flags retained even when value is masked
quality_flags.source_code_W: WBAN/ASOS Summary of the Day from Integrated Surface Data

spatial_assumptions.projection: WGS84 treated as working datum, local azimuthal equidistant centred at 41.5 N, 75 W; source coordinate datum not independently established
spatial_assumptions.grid: Model predictions at geographic cell centres, not new station observations; retain only cells with all corners inside station convex hull

limitations: Selected station records are complete and carry blank quality flags; rejection/missing branches are tested on explicitly altered copies, not relabelled field data.
Reference period is deliberately short and not homogenized; station moves, urban effects, elevation and long-term climate trends are not estimated.
Spatial holdout shares region and year; errors are descriptive, not independent confidence intervals or forecasts.
Final grid and its area mean are model-derived summaries within support, not measured regional climate truth.
